title: Identify the name of the tallest player among those who have played as away
question: Identify the name of the tallest player among those who have played as away player 5 in matches where their team lost (i.e., away_team_goal < home_team_goal) and who also have a potential score of exactly 61.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p."XCL_123"
FROM Player AS p
INNER JOIN Match AS m ON p."XCL_122" = m."XCL_075"
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON p."XCL_122" = pa."XCL_130"
WHERE m."XCL_016" < m."XCL_015"
  AND pa."XCL_133" = 61
ORDER BY p."XCL_126" DESC
LIMIT 1
